evidence_roles.depth: nearest measured LiDAR within1.5px; not dense GT
evidence_roles.road: plane-close measured non-object returns; not semantic GT
evidence_roles.masks: required five-ID + all-vehicle + native proposal union

limitations: No confirmed exposure means prior, not recovered hidden texture.
Unlabeled occluders and sparse depth gaps fail closed where evidence is absent.
No learned exposure correction; original sRGB and robust residual retained.
Thin 3D Gaussians are not a replacement 2DGS rasterizer.

prior_boundary_graph.interpretation: context reach is graph evidence only; disabled prior arm has no prior anchor objective; unanchored stays explicit, never texture GT
